app.title: TextFromTrack Roon Companion

status.backend_offline_hint: Cannot reach the local server — check that the backend is running

roon.authorize_prompt: Open Roon → Settings → Extensions and enable

match.confirm_medium: Confidence is not high — confirm before sending

tft.no_token: No API key configured — add your TextFromTrack key in ⚙ Settings
tft.invalid_token: API key rejected (401) — regenerate your token on textfromtrack.com and update it in ⚙ Settings
tft.no_credits: No credits remaining — top up your account on textfromtrack.com
tft.lyrics_exist: Lyrics already exist — check "Re-transcribe" above to overwrite
tft.no_match: No local file matched for this track — the file is required to generate lyrics
tft.low_confidence_warning: The file match confidence is low — the matched file may be incorrect.
tft.low_confidence_confirm: I understand — proceed anyway with this file
tft.low_confidence_confirm_required: Please confirm the low-confidence match to proceed
tft.force_retranscribe: Re-transcribe even if lyrics already exist
tft.force_warning: Existing .lrc will be deleted; existing LYRICS tag will be renamed to LYRICS.ORG.
tft.embed_lyrics: Also embed [LYRICS] tag in audio file
tft.embed_unsupported: Embedding not supported for {{ext}} files (MP3 / FLAC only)
tft.backup_before_embed: Save a .org backup of the original file first
tft.save_lrc_beside_source: Save LRC file next to audio source
tft.lyrics_embedded_ok: Lyrics embedded into the audio file
tft.quality_degraded: Low quality — some segments may have been removed
tft.phase_retrying: Quality too low — retrying with vocal isolation…
tft.help_audio_type: Auto: let TFT decide. Speech: optimised for voice. Music: activates Demucs vocal isolation and a stricter hallucination filter.
tft.help_timestamps: Auto: TFT decides. Required: forces LRC-compatible timestamps. None: text-only output, faster.
tft.help_language: ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, en, ja). Leave blank for automatic detection.
tft.help_vintage: Forces large-v3 model and Demucs separation. Much slower (~6×) but may give better results for difficult tracks.

jobs.no_timestamps_tip: Timestamps unavailable — fallback model was used. Click 🔄 to retry.
jobs.no_timestamps_tip_with_mode: Timestamps unavailable — TFT applied mode "{{mode}}" (requested "{{requested}}"). Click 🔄 to retry.
jobs.no_timestamps_tip_v17_missing: Timestamps unavailable. Requested "{{requested}}" but the TFT response did not echo timestamps_mode — the deployed API likely pre-dates v1.7 and silently ignored the param. Retry will not help until TFT v1.7 is deployed.
jobs.retry_tip: Delete this LRC and re-submit for transcription
jobs.embedded_tip: Lyrics also embedded as [LYRICS] tag in the audio file
jobs.embed_tip: Embed [LYRICS] tag into the audio file now
jobs.backup_conflict_body: A backup already exists at the path below. What should we do?
jobs.lyrics_not_available: Lyrics not available for this job

settings.volume_step_hint: How many units the volume changes on each + / − click in the player.
settings.roon_poll_ms_hint: How often the now-playing info is refreshed (progress bar, volume…). Lower = more reactive, higher = less network traffic.
settings.embed_lyrics_default: Embed [LYRICS] tag in audio file by default
settings.embed_lyrics_default_hint: When enabled, the LRC content is also written into the file's LYRICS tag (MP3 ID3v2 USLT, FLAC Vorbis comment). The .lrc sidecar is still saved.
settings.backup_before_embed_default_hint: Creates Track.flac.org / Track.mp3.org next to the original before any tag write, so the file can be restored if anything goes wrong.
settings.save_lrc_beside_source_default: Save LRC file next to audio source
settings.save_lrc_beside_source_default_hint: When enabled, the .lrc sidecar file is saved next to the audio file. Roon does not read LRC files natively — leave this off if you only use embedded lyrics.
settings.server_log_hint: Last lines of the server log — useful for remote debugging
settings.log_empty: Log file is empty or not yet created.
settings.log_unavailable: Log unavailable (dev mode — Electron not running)
settings.sys_info_hint: Runtime memory and disk usage for the current session
